text_block_list.text:
The Overlord is victorious! A tribute to
my worthy
foe for a riveting competition!
A tribute to my
fans for an outstanding
ovation!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
However... this ruler who vies to become
the
Centurial Overlord must remain
steadfast at the
top of this generation.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Thus, I advance my pieces onward to the

Japanese Derby, a fitting venue to
further bolster
my name!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
